T-001.threat: Data tampering on incoming flow: Attacker modifies data before it reaches {{targetName}}
T-001.cause: Missing integrity protection on the data flow from {{sourceName}} — data arrives without tamper evidence
T-001.attack: Attacker intercepts the data flow from {{sourceName}} and modifies commands or payload before delivery to {{targetName}}

T-002.threat: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches {{sourceName}}
T-002.cause: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from {{targetName}} — {{sourceName}} cannot detect modified responses
T-002.attack: Attacker intercepts the response from {{targetName}} and modifies data, causing {{sourceName}} to process falsified information
